notes.title: A New Multiplayer Game From 2 Blazing Sails Devs!
notes.content:
Ahoy mateys,

While we be hard at work patching sails and sharpening cutlasses for the next big update in Blazing Sails, we’ve got some juicy word from across the seas to share with ye!

[b]Two of our finest former Get Up Games crewmates, Frederic and Christophe[/b], have charted a new course and started their own studio: [b]Fancy Cat Interactive[/b] (a name that surely strikes fear into the hearts of landlubbers everywhere). These fine lads have been busy craftin’ a brand new game, and it goes by the name of…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/0d9fc5c39a86bd1d8d8c63236adb0d3b97399cde.png[/img]
Now this one ain't about swashbucklin’! This is [b]a cartoony Multiplayer WWII shooter[/b], where ye trade in yer flintlocks and cutlasses for flyin’ contraptions and thunderin’ wheel-cannons! It’s[b] like Blazing Sails crash-landed in the 1940s[/b], where a new world of battles awaits your grand entrance.

[b]Same chaotic, action-packed multiplayer spirit ye know and love[/b], but this time, it’s all boots on the ground (and occasionally in the air), with uniforms instead of peg legs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/0acf0f04b7a793b8c893658f98ca47cf4d480f01.png[/img]

[h5]Best news o’ all? You can join the [u]free playtest[/u] right now and jump into the fray![/h5]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504090/Heroes_of_Valor/

So if ye feel like tradin’ yer fish hat for a tin helmet, give it a go, and let the bullets fly!

Meanwhile, back on the high seas, we’re [b]still chartin’ the course for some exciting updates in Blazing Sails[/b]. So, keep yer spyglasses aimed at the horizon… there's treasure to be had, and maybe a few surprises too.

[url=https://discord.gg/dMAZcUxy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/fa282e62a94b2235e703e6bce9173ea41500fe50.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Halloween Update: The Undead Fleet Rises...
notes.content:
[h3]Ahoy seadogs,[/h3]

The spookiest time of the year is upon us—Halloween be creepin' up like a ghost ship in the dead of night! And it be lookin’ like [b]a host of wretched ghouls[/b] is coming to wreak havoc across the seven seas! 

[h4][u][b]Special Halloween Game Mode: Rise of the Undead Fleet[/b][/u][/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/623bcd2440b51371c72e0ab7786aecb61eec34a8.png[/img]
[i]Screenshot by Community member toothboto[/i]

For this year’s spooky season, we’re bringing you an [b]exclusive, seasonal game mode! From today 'till November 14th, you can conquer the [i]Rise of the Undead Fleet.[/i] [/b]

Undead Fleet can be played with [b]up to 15 players[/b]. Twelve human pirates face off against three Undead. Each player has their own sloop, and the Undead aim to board and sink the human ships. Once a ship goes down, its [b]crew turns and joins the Undead[/b]. 

[b]The Undead win if they sink all human ships![/b]

While the Undead are trying to capsize their ships, Humans need to track down treasure chests scattered across the map. Once they find a chest, they need to deliver it to Mr. Bones.[b] If the humans gather 5000 gold before the timer runs out, they'll seize victory![/b]

That be soundin' excitin', right mateys? Along with the new game mode, we’ll be [b]rolling out a bunch of patches[/b], which you can read about right [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1158940/view/4540283856248373365?l=english]here[/url].

So, pirates, beware the monsters lurking in the shadows, for All Hallows' Eve is nearly here. Get ready to sharpen yer cutlasses and prepare for a night o' fright!

notes.title: Blazing Sails - Loud and behold, the voice chat is here again!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/402ca9298c97fce829060305503df906afe7abd3.png[/img]

Avast, ye seadogs!

'Tis time for another round of updates, and this time, we've got a treasure trove of improvements for ye. We're introducing a slew of balance changes, bug fixes, quality of life enhancements, and best of all, the return of voice chat! So rally yer crew, hoist the sails, and prepare to rule the seas once more!

[b]Voice Chat is Back![/b]
[list]
[*] Practice your sea shanties with your crew, or yell at them to raise the capstan. Communication is key and with voice you can coordinate your team so much more! 
[*] Currently only available on Dedicated Servers!
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage holes have been reworked a little in this update. The damage / hole is now 25 capped. The flow rate code is also no longer rounding numbers. The flowrate = the damage to the hole / 3 every damage tick.
[*] Removed some of the distant Gun Game spawn points on Forsaken Fort.
[*] Disabled one of the islands for spawning on Bone Barge map for Gun Game.
[*] Tweaked the starting rotation of almost all ship spawn points in Battle Royale.
[*] Added land cannons throughout the map.
[*] Added the Fuse lighter as melee weapon in Battle Royale, Rare tier.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Base implementation of the new tick reduction system. This new system will allow us to tweak some components of the game to get increase performance. Values for these systems still need to be heavily tweaked throughout the next couple of updates.
[*] A Jumping puzzle / parkour element has been added to the pregame lobby
[*] Streamer mode will also hide your level now.
[*] Added tick optimization module as a base for improving performance.
[*] Added additional party UI above the friends list.
[*] Added more detailed UI elements to the Ship Info (water level meter) to show the cork and anchor information.
[*] Explosive barrels respawn now in the Shooting Range.
[*] Backpack also respawns in the Shooting Range.
[*] Reduced the time it takes to go into the crows nest 4 -> 3 seconds.
[*] Added command to enable Friendly Fire.
[*] Added command to enable Ship collision damage.
[*] Added command to drop weapons on death.
[*] Changed the color of server messages to be different than team messages.
[*] Added option to disable join / leave messages from players joining.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed crew size selection on the Host screen not applying.
[*] Fixed Forsaken Fort map being completely dark when stormy weather is active.
[*] Fixed Tutorial level not loading actions.
[*] Fixed internal issue with Time of Day system.
[*] Fixed loading screen not showing the Time of Day.
[*] Fixed the explosive barrels in water colliding and stopping the ship rather than exploding.
[*] Fixed Gun Game weapon not changing when getting a kill while dying.
[*] Fixed custom Gun Game weapon order not saving correctly.
[*] Fixed Team members being able to interrupt Cork or Steering wheel interactions.
[*] Added fallback system to prevent 'spectator servers' where no players would spawn.
[/list]

That's all for today's update! Thank you again for being part of this community! Stay tuned for more updates, and let's set sail for the high seas!

notes.title: Blazing Sails - Spring Cleaning Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/293379b534ca2d51829858120edd456299a841f1.png[/img]

Ahoy, me hearties! 

Spring has sprung, and it's time for a grand spring cleaning on the high seas! Prepare for adventure as we introduce new dedicated Gun Game servers, alongside balance tweaks and Quality of Life improvements to keep your plunderin' smooth. So rally yer crew and set sail, for excitement awaits with this bountiful update!

[b]New Dedicated Gamemode on Servers![/b]
[list]
[*] Add dedicated Gun Game server, rotating out Conquest (still available for Custom Matches)
[*] Conquest will be put back in rotation at a future date.
[/list]
[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduce the amount of treasure chests spawning
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Allow Explosive barrels to be picked up when in the water
[*] Allow the player to look around while adjusting the sails
[*] Add end of server timer on end game scoreboard, this allows players in Gun Game servers to wait and be automatically put into a new lobby without having to requeue.
[*] Allow players to switch teams using the crew banner flags (Only available in Custom Lobbies)*
[*] Add additional Gun Game UI to show the gun progression + current leader
[*] Change default keybinds for interact and loot to be separate! F is default to Loot now instead of E*
[*] Opened Treasure chests now gray out on the world map if either you or a team mate saw the chest open
[/list]
[b]Vote Kick reimplemented[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix issues with vote kicking
[*] Add additional Vote kick UI
[*] Fix issue with Blunderbuss in Gun Game
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix issue with the click region on the end game score board
[*] Fix numerous small issues
[*] Fix some of the order of which team player info synced
[*] Fix issue where the custom match would end early if you are only one team, the match should continue as normal now.
[*] Fix Pirate and Ship Presets
[/list]

[b]Others[/b]
[list]
[*] To help investigate the some of the servers having performance issues, we have added more analytics to pinpoint the underlying issues
[*] We're still working on the new and improved back end system. Which should bring improvements to match making and player stats.
[/list]

And last but not least, Blazing Sails is half the price at 50% off until April 22nd. So if you or your friend has been waiting on the best moment, don't miss out on this steal of a deal!

Thank you for being apart of this community! And as always, stay tuned for more updates, and we'll see you on the high seas!

🏴‍☠️ The Get Up Crew

notes.title: Jan 6th Server Update
notes.content:
During the Holidays we faced some devastating issues with our backend that caused far more servers to spawn than ever thought necessary. So we had to take the painful decision to temporarily take the servers offline till we could identify the issues, implement fixes and more fail saves to prevent this from happening. 

It took a bit longer than we wanted, but all the new systems are in place. So official dedicated servers are now back! Go queue up for your favorite game mode!

Since we were about half way development for the next patch, there are a few changes in this patch too:

***New Features:***
* Conquest game mode is now best out of 3
* Conquest Flag icon now represents the 'capture amount'
* Conquest starting loadout is now the default loadout
* Sniper glints are now hidden during ADS

***Bugs:***
* Conquest ship sinking not depleting the right amount of tickets
* Gun game uses correct blunderbuss now

Again we apologize for the servers being unavailable during this time, but hope you understand that serious actions had to be taken to prevent more damage. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: 3.0.1.3 - 1st of December Patch!
notes.content:
Ahoy, ye seadogs!

After successfully launching the full game and sailin' through the turbulent waters of bug fixing post-launch, we've finally found a moment to take a breath and gather our thoughts. This journey's been a real whirlwind, and we wanted to extend our deepest gratitude to all you pirates who have supported us for many years by reporting those pesky bugs. Ye be the true MVPs (= Most Valuable Pirates). 

First of all, we know that the full release of Blazing Sails has been a long time coming. As you guys know, we're a small crew. Throughout the last couple of years, we've faced mighty headwinds as we sailed through development, passing through waves of unexpected events, both in our professional and personal lives. So we appreciate everyone who stayed the course, hoping that we didn't abandon the development of this game. We never intended to and we didn't! And to the ones who had lost faith and cursed at us many times - like SO many, you wouldn’t believe it, we hope that this message reaches you and that you give our game another try!

We're over the moon that we've weathered the storm. Our dedication to fine-tuning this game is stronger than ever, and we're committed to ensure it becomes the gem we’ve always wanted it to be. To our fantastic community, you're the wind in our sails, and we couldn't have come this far without your hearty support! And fear not! We’ve got many more exciting updates on the horizon - some that you might recognize, and some that are brand new. Stay tuned, mateys!

So, after all this emotional talk, we can confidently say: It's time to set sail and venture forward! 

… As you shoot, stab, blast, bomb, and sink your way across the seven seas, of course. ARRR!

***Patch Notes:***

**New Features**:
- Return of spawn selection
- New "vote for ship type"
- New flag added
- Hid the queue number when streamer mode is active
- Hid matchmaking queue when not party host and streamer mode is active

**Bugs**:
- Fixed soft lock when completion occurred for Shooting Range challenge
- Joining Gun Game while match in progress now works appropriately
- Fixed Gun Game "Battle Starting" screen
- Fixed issue with streamer mode names on the winning trophies not displaying appropriately
- Skeleton voices re-added as selections
- Fixed pre-game lobby sometimes not starting a match when timer ended
- Fixed bullet collision on rear window of Caravel
- Improved cannon collisions 
- Fixed hammer incidentally being taken out when boarding a ship via ladders
- Improved default weapon swapping system
- Removed non-existent small island from map 

**Balance changes**:
- Trapshot rarity increased, increased stacks from 1-1 to 1-2
- Anti-cannon rarity increased, stacks reduced from 2-3 to 1-2
- Heavy cannonball stacks reduced from 2-8 to 2-5
- Capstan now has a 1 second delay after the anchor drops before it can be progressed
- Removed ability to repair enemy ship damages
- Added ship spawn points around Maze

notes.title: Blazing Sails Full release!
notes.content:
Ahoy buccaneers! Today we are putting our ship that is Blazing Sails to sea. We are leaving the safe harbor of early access and are setting sail for new horizons!

[previewyoutube=ANI6LYQo5sk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Rise of the Caravel[/h1]

What better way to celebrate a milestone such as this than with a new ship: The Caravel! A big bulky ship with a high forecastle and aftcastle. Great for throwing yourselves onto an enemy ship's deck. Airborne pirate assaults await ye. They will never see you coming! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/206104fc30918c9bbdf4eb222f9cd968108a824f.jpg[/img]

The Caravel sports one main cannon on each side and a hidden rear cannon. Sometimes you just need to show your dominance through [i]ahem[/i] showing them your butt.

Aside from a butt cannon there are multiple swivels and 3 masts. It takes a bit more effort to man this hulk, but when doing so efficiently you can terrorize the seas with a literal floating fortress.

[h1]Introducing the Limbs of Lore[/h1]

We've also dropped a brand new DLC filled with swagelicious pirate prosthetics. Time to fashion up those missing limbs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672710/Blazing_Sails__Limbs_of_Lore_Pack/?curator_clanid=35818716

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

And as per usual we have also worked on fixing more of those pesky bugs such as the bottle bug, crow's nest weapon switch issues, XP loading and more!

[h1]Sailing onward...[/h1]

But of course, we'll keep sailing and exploring new seas. We have more stuff and bug fixes planned for the coming weeks and months as well as the return of some beloved game modes and features such as conquest and the curse. We'll be sharing a new roadmap that will shed more light on the future of Blazing Sails soon! So stay tuned for that.

So it's time to grab that unbugged bottle and climb aboard the Caravel to claim those winner winner, pirate dinners!

Cheers!

notes.content:
Arrrr... ye be feelin that lads? Those cold chills running down yer spine? Aye, it be that time again of the year when the drowned pirate ghosts and undead parrots visit your doorstep! So, bring out the pumpkins and light the candles, it's time to get SPOOKY! ːblazingsailsː

Today we've got a nice Halloween update paired with some much MUCH (and I can not stress this enough how much this was requested) XP and item reward chests! Yes, you persistent buccaneers, it's finally here! God save the pirate queen!

Here's a rundown of what's new:

-Deathzone damage now scales the deeper you are in the zone (mostly noticeable in the final zone)

notes.title: A New Chapter
notes.content:
👋  Ahoy, pirates of the high seas! 👋 

After a period of silence on the Blazing Sails front, we're back with some significant changes. We've been hard at work below deck, and we want to give you a rundown of what to expect from this update.

What's New?
🌊 Engine Update to 4.27: We've upgraded our game engine to version 4.27, which brings improvements and optimizations to the game.

🌐 Switch to EOS (Epic Online Services): We've set our sights beyond the horizon! Blazing Sails has shifted from a Steam-based API to EOS, Epic's Online Services. This move unlocks new possibilities for the game, including an enhanced matchmaking system, setting the course for a brighter and more dynamic future.

🌐 New Servers on AWS: Our servers are back and have been rebuilt from the ground up in Amazon's AWS infrastructure. This should provide a more stable and reliable gaming experience.

🎮 New Experimental Game Mode: Introducing a new and experimental game mode called "Gungame." Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled showdown with a unique twist.

🚫 Temporary Removals: We've made some temporary adjustments for this update. Features like the conquest game mode and 2-player ships have been temporarily disabled as we fine-tune and improve them for a future release.

We appreciate your patience and support during this transition. As we launch this update, please bear in mind that there may be some hiccups along the way. Our team is dedicated to addressing any issues that may arise.

Stay tuned for more info in the coming weeks. We're eager to have you back on board to experience Blazing Sails in this new era.

🏴‍☠️ The Get Up Crew

notes.title: Update Preview: Two Player Ship!
notes.content:
Ahoy! It’s been a while mateys…

And boy do we have something to share with ye’ all! Over the last few weeks we’ve been hard at work adding various QoL improvements to the game, especially in treasure hunt hoping to get more people to try out the new gamemode. More detailed descriptions of these exact improvements will be shared in the next patch notes.

But that’s not all pirates. Since the start of our Early Access journey we’ve seen many suggestions come and go but we did notice one in particular that just keeps popping back up. A TWO PLAYER SHIP! So being the dangerously obedient devs we are, we’ve made a little sloop for ye’ salty sea dogs.


[h3]Meet The Sloop![/h3]

The sloop will be available in both the BR and Treasure Hunt gamemode and is designed for max. 2 players/crew. Meaning that it should be able to handle the bigger 4 player crews.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/5781b56f1474cac1bbb716e4befb621550b81f8d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/aa9963c412f755c9bb92f289290c549fa23fcf20.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/48a1e98fb12175be8ef09949e95c057e546ce770.png[/img]

Everything on the deck and below is compact and easily reachable so you don’t need as many hands like with the other ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/f33d4cd26083cd74fbafeea7be1e7018e03317c5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/b6f2f203e8c04d73c169c39bd87f3db0f9b5a67c.gif[/img]

Meanwhile, the sloop is fast and agile while also packing a punch with its many swivel positions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/e6d41bf34973f14baa9bd5994e842980d644d475.gif[/img]

It also handles like a charm with its short steering radius and fast sail deployment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/c33fd9dfc0db53fd5f1b9189c16066af1b280530.gif[/img]

Boarding the sloop might also prove difficult for your enemies since it's equipped with only one ladder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/08421a46aafefcd7f7520b0cb3f230bdee681a77.gif[/img]

In terms of hull strength, the sloop compares to the brigantine. This way we want to even the odds of winning with a smaller crew size.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/6502ce433be9f8324d2e41a578508c4158b42bd2.gif[/img]


Hope you’re excited mateys! We hope to release the sloop + more sweet improvements very soon in our next update!


[h3]What about the Early Access Roadmap?[/h3]

Usually we announce big updates like this one in our Roadmap instead of via a preview. Behind the scenes we’re working on some other big stuff and we just haven't figured out yet what the next part of the roadmap should exactly contain.

notes.title: Version 1.7.5.2: Shooting Range, sniper glint and more!
notes.content:
Ahoy pirates!

We're dropping a new small update a bit sooner than anticipated to fix the issues we've experienced with our back-end. However, we've got a few cool new additions stowed away in this one. 

We've added a shooting range that you can use to practice your pirate eye. It includes all of the game's weapons, some bullseye targets, a few ships, cannons and more! So go wild and sharpen that aim.

Secondly we've also added a sniper scope glint. This will make it easier to spot those deadly sharpshooters. The glint will appear when another player using a sniper rifle looks at you.

Next to that we've also improved ship and land collisions a bit which should fix the teleporting up onto buildings, or teleporting up onto a deck from below when making odd movements around staircases.

Conquest has also gotten some improvements such as weighted flags which should make it so the next flag will now have a higher chance to be a flag far away instead of a flag that's very close by. Point reduction amounts have been rebalanced, flags can now only be captured while uncontested and more!

Read all about the changes and additions in detail below.

[b]Note: We're still updating the main menu's news image, this will work in our next small hotfix.[/b]

[u]Patch notes: [/u]

[h3]Practice addition:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new shooting range map (practice card under the play menu) including bullseye targets with damage feedback, ships, cannons and all weapons
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a sniper scope glint (visible when an enemy sniper wielding player aims in your general direction)
[*] Cross-hair screen accuracy improved
[*] Added some invisible ship colliders to Kraken Keep to prevent ships getting stuck on shallows
[*] Slightly increased cannon right click zoom from 20% to 30%
[*] Final zone music in BR now loops
[/list]

[h3]Profanity tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Profanity filter now automatically enabled when toggling streamer mode ON
[/list]

[h3]Conquest tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fish launcher now costs 2500 gold
[*] Flags can no longer be captured while enemy players are contesting the flag
[*] Flags can no longer be captured from underneath (exploit)
[*] Pre-game timer changed to 210 seconds (3.5 minutes)
[*] Ship sink point depletion amount increased from 300/400 to 350/450 (depending on player count)
[*] Spawn on wreckage time reduced to 10 seconds after sinking
[*] Flag randomization now uses weights (furthest flags have more chance to be chosen)
[/list]

[h3]Collision improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved ground snap detection which should make it impossible to teleport up onto buildings or high walls
[*] Improved ship staircase collisions which should fix strange upward teleporting
[*] Ship wall / railing detection improved which should fix accidentally warping over railings or falling off the ship
[/list]

[h3]Visual tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced noon time of day water specular intensity a bit (was much too bright)
[*] Improved Trident beam effects and texture
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed galleon ladder climbing offset
[*] Fixed a bug that caused loadout selection screen to appear on top of winning screen when dying right before end-game in conquest
[*] Damage points on ships should now be visible again while spectating
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7.2: First person animation improvements, new sound effects and more!
notes.content:
Happy New Year pirates!

We hope you all enjoyed the holidays and found some love, hugs, kisses, rum, treasure and whatnot.
To start off the new year we've prepared a small update bringing some much needed love to some of the aspects that had been forgotten. Namely, the quality of the first person experience, the movement system and the sounds.

[b]In today's update we're introducing an important change which may require some getting used to if you've been playing the game for a while. We've introduced reduced air control. What does this mean, you wonder? Well, before today pirates were also birds as they were able to literally glide around in the air, often making it very difficult for other players to hit them or even see them at times. With reduced air control gliding in mid air is much more limited. You can still change your direction a little bit while in the air, but you will mostly jump towards your initial jump direction. Currently air control is set to 40% which still gives enough control to adjust your jump trajectory slightly. This change should make close combat a lot more fun and engaging.[/b]

As for the first person tweaks, there's a couple of new things. 

Your weapons will now always remain visible, even when sprinting, but instead of disappearing they are now held down. And landing after a jump now has a bounce animation.

We've also changed the game's field of view system which now uses a vertical lock instead of a horizontal lock meaning widescreen monitors will now be able to fully enjoy the game as it's intended without awkward cropping. [b]Note, that this change may require you to readjust your mouse sensitivity and FOV setting.[/b]

And we've also tweaked quite a few weapon sounds to make them more distinctive, more punchy and just generally of higher quality.


[u]Patch notes: [/u]

[h3]Movement:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Air control reduction added (40% down from 100%) reducing the amount of control you have while jumping
[/list]

[h3]Field of view (FOV):[/h3]
[list]
[*] Field of view is now locked vertically instead of horizontally
[/list]

[h3]First person animations:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New sprinting weapon animations (weapons are now held down instead of disappearing)
[*] Jump land bounce animation added
[/list]

[h3]New / tweaked sounds:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New water splash sound
[*] Flintlock sound tweaked
[*] Quad-barrel flintlock sound tweaked
[*] Heavy / fast sniper sounds tweaked
[*] New musket sound

[*] New double barrel sound
[*] Repeater sound tweaked
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7.0: New Galleon Ship, Conquistador DLC & more!
notes.content:
Ahoy me hearties!

We hope you are all doing well on these cold days. However, If you are in need of some warmth, than the nice and sun bathed islands of Blazing Sails are ready for you with today's big update.

The time has finally come to set sail on one of the most iconic vessels of the pirate era. The galleon! A massive ship that only the bravest pirate crews dared take a prize.
In today's big update you'll be able to start sailing this monster together with up to 10 pirates.

[h2]New ship: The Galleon[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/75685073f6079deb2cc7232607ac71b75311f3aa.jpg[/img]

The galleon is the largest ship in the game. It can be fully customized like any other ship in the main menu. However, currently it's only available in the conquest game mode.

The gun deck
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/2b8749d35e771d2076c776558dbbe55db637245e.jpg[/img]

The captain's cabin which grants access to the balcony
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/259236e7e4b190f6e5762ac7c4252f369c9e94fa.jpg[/img]

The lower deck
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/c2e0878e1b1b927c4af023914560539173f5523f.jpg[/img]

In terms of ship stats the galleon has a slow turn speed, slow acceleration, medium speed and 18 cannons.

[h3]Galleon cannons[/h3]

The cannons on the galleon are a special type of cannon that can only be fired once before they overheat. After a short while an overheated cannon will be cooled down and ready to be fired again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/9abc88f146ee91c2d2ab11015d37d78dffef515c.jpg[/img]

Here's some more interesting Galleon statistics for you: The galleon has a whopping 18 cannons, 2 swivel cannons, 3 masts, 7 sails, 6 decks, a balcony, a captain's quarter and a beak head. It's unlike any of the other ships in the game. 

A wise pirate once said; with great power comes great.. destruction! So put on your best sea-legs (or peg legs) and crew up with 9 other pirates to fire off a devastating broadside and claim victory in our newly adjusted conquest gamemode.

[h2]Conquest Changes[/h2]

The new conquest (now called Galleon Conquest) is currently the only mode that includes the galleon and with that in mind we altered it a bit. Spawns are now much closer to the islands making it easier to retaliate and recapture flags. There is now only one random flag active at a time but after having captured it for a period of time it will switch to another random flag. So you'll have to stay mobile and get ready to move as soon as the flag is switched. 

The galleon plays a vital role as it is a mobile spawn platform. But bringing about destruction upon the enemy galleon will deplete enemy tickets with a significant amount as well. So the choice is yours to fight for control over the flag or sink the enemy, or both!

[h2]Conquistador Pack DLC[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/50b8bdb2bdb3d5a43f2f97cfb127e9f9364e1ebd.png[/img]

With the galleon ship sailing around raining down volleys of cannonballs also comes a fearsome army of conquerors wearing armor plates. Introducing the Conquistador DLC.

This awesome collection of armor and helmets will surely turn you into a killing machine. Spread fear among the battlefield with one of 5 material and color variations including both open and closed helmet designs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/7c9cec390d17803480c95b0f3eb098a5be3faa48.jpg[/img]

[h2]Buy it here:[/h2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1815620/Blazing_Sails__Conquistador_Pack/

[h2]Further game improvements[/h2]

We've also included a few more improvements in this update such as a revised spawn selection screen for BR with improved knife animation, new sound effects and a big circle highlighting the different selectable clusters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/f0ef0fa22f0d08ef34ca5d81d3fea4b840f8a1a3.jpg[/img]

And also a new ship selector in the main menu to make it even easier to select your favorite ship before going into battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/64a9da603e4491dff21fc249443d1847297353ae.jpg[/img]

Finally we've of course also included some bug fixes and other tweaks as per usual.

So..
There's a lot to check out. Time to dust of that cutlass and get out there pirate! Yarrr!!!!

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[h3]New Ship Type Galleon:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Galleon ship type has been added to the game (can be customized in main menu but currently only available in conquest)
[/list]

[h3]Conquest tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Galleon made available in conquest (other ships disabled for now)
[*] Flag now automatically swaps to a random other flag when a certain amount of tickets has been drained from enemy team
[*] Ships spawn now much closer to the islands
[*] Conquest server names adjusted (removed experimental and now called Galleon Conquest)
[/list]

[h3]Quality of life:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spectator cam now also uses proper field of view and updates live when changed in options
[/list]

[h3]Sound tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mortar sound tweaked a bit to sound more different from normal cannons
[/list]

[h3]UI improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] BR spawn selection improved with cluster circles and new knife drop animations and sound effects
[*] Main menu ship selector now 3 buttons for faster ship selecting and more polished look
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jumping into the water while teleporting no longer hides amulet
[*] Going out of the water while teleporting no longer hides the amulet
[*] Fixed a bug that caused cannons not to be loadable first time you use one until you switch ammo
[/list]

notes.title: The Lord of the Sails: The Return of the Roadmap
notes.content:
Ahoy! It’s high time for another [b]Roadmap Update![/b] 

As mentioned in previous announcements, we’ve decided to postpone our full launch. And this, well... because we ain't done yet! There’s still a reasonable amount of stuff to add, explore and polish until we can confidently call our game “done”.

Many of you have been asking about future plans and what we intend to add in the next coming months. Of course, we reflected on this and now feel comfortable to unveil the next steps. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/769a057528e019e6929da2df6a5cac9e99e530bf.jpg[/img]

As some of you might remember, we’ve asked you all to fill out a feedback form so that we may get a better understanding of what you pirates think about the current state of the game, what your desires are, etc… We have learned a lot from that! We would like to thank everyone that took the time to give us this valuable feedback!

A lot of you would definitely recommend Blazing Sails in its current state and think we’ve improved the game a lot during Early Access. But generally we do see a need for more polish and more features. Mainly 2 things caught our attention. Many of you would love to see more ship options and more game modes!

We’ll do our very best to fulfill these needs and implement this feedback in the coming updates. This was also the main thing we kept in mind while brainstorming about our Roadmap. 

That being said, game development is a costly affair. We needed to find some creative solutions so that we’re able to bridge these extra few months of development time. Therefore we’ll also be adding quite a lot of new awesome DLC cosmetics in the coming time. We’ve got some sweet ideas and are excited to work on these epic and sometimes wacky pirate costumes! Buying DLC is a great way to support our development during Early Access and really helps us to continue working on the features that add a lot of value to the overall game. 

Hope you are excited for what we’ve got planned! In the end we want Blazing Sails to be in the best possible state upon full launch so that you and your friends may keep enjoying epic pirate PvP battles for a long time!


[h3]Without further ado, our Roadmap:[/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.6.5.5: Tiki sets, new level based unlocks, conquest improvements & more
notes.content:
Hi there me lads!

We've been very busy lately with some long term stuff which is why it's been a bit quiet last few weeks. But we've also been working on a new update which we're releasing today!

Today's update includes a complete new Tiki inspired set, ancient crowns, new ancient tattoos, new facial hair types, new earrings and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/757fc6d91a36bcd64039c258e1c32605fe76c8e3.gif[/img]

We've also added some awesome new level based unlockables on the progression timeline, like a grim reaper bow figure, a monocle, a dagger in the mouth and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/309d77c334fb143b4869176aeab2a36dde479ac9.png[/img]

[b]So far we've added 5 unlockable cosmetics to the first few levels and 1 towards the end of the progression timeline. This is only the first of many to come though, as we will add more and more with each new update! Upcoming items include unique peg legs, hats, hooks, face items and more![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/92c4138c8a1b60f062360c0a9a86758600fdfbb1.gif[/img]

Aside from new cosmetics we've also reworked conquest a bit by reducing the amount of active flags from 3 to 1 to create a bit more conflict and shift the focus more on combat instead of running around the map capturing flags. We're still very much tweaking the conquest gamemode so keep in mind that changes like these are still experimental. We've also fixed some exploits and improved ship respawning so it's no longer possible to spawnkill new ships. Aside from that the ticket depletion is now also based on server player amount and crew size.

We've also vastly improved the tutorial with many more visual cues, cleaner tooltips, new animations and more in-between steps to make the tutorial experience as easy to follow as possible.

[b]And that's not all! We've now also enabled the Steam Community items![/b] Trading cards, badges, backgrounds and emoticons can now be collected! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/4cad6109854f63114a1a422390729ce993526a53.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.6.4.4: Storm Setting, More Conquest Maps and news about Full Launch
notes.content:
Ahoy Mateys! 

Time for another update! But before that we’ve got something to talk about...

Many of you might have already gotten your hard earned pirate gold ready to buy Blazing Sails for yourself or a friend upon full release later this month. In the meantime we’ve been hard at work fixing the last bugs and improving the game even more to get it all set up. However, reflecting on the game as a team, we realised we don't think we're done with Early Access. The reason we released in EA from the very beginning has been to receive player feedback and get Blazing Sails to a place we're uniformly proud of - and we don't think we're there yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/6405449bcb4260f5e5db0484032da495019091bc.png[/img]

That being said, we don’t want to leave you pirates in the dark. Therefore we’ve decided to already release the [b]Storm Setting[/b] and [b]Extra Conquest Maps[/b] in this free update! 

We’d also like to take this opportunity to ask for a bit of feedback from you all! What do you think about the current state of the game? What can we add for a successful full launch? And why? We’d love to find out what you think of all this. Therefore we have created this [url=https://forms.gle/FMz6TmQaPrJq2nr68][b]handy form[/b][/url]

Thanks in advance for the valuable feedback pirates! On a sidenote, we're working on some major plans we'll be able to reveal soon™! Hope you’re excited.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE! Pirate Progression, Ghost Ship, Hammer Skins, and Much More!
notes.content:
Ahoy mateys! 

It's been a bit since our last update, and that is because we've been saving up for something [b]BIG![/b]

[u]We've prepared this little trailer that shows our progress during Early Access + The latest additions:[/u]

[previewyoutube=I3VvZDyAH7I;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Pirate Progression[/h2]

While we think our game has improved a lot during the last few months of Early Access we always felt like our game was missing some of that special sauce that just keeps you interested even after playing many, many matches. [b]Gone are those days![/b] From now on, every completed match will reward you with experience to increase your Pirate Level! At the same time level based unlocks like: [b]Special Chests, Hammer Skins[/b] and epic [b]Pirate Titles[/b] will contribute in giving you something to work towards while leveling up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/545513a41043db780e459759835818d80910cb33.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/a7f7be00f897a5dd9f881da9d96a98e66455762c.gif[/img]

In the meantime we've revamped the loot drop system. Instead of getting some random items after a match you'll now get either a normal or winner chest (or both!) when winning matches and leveling up. This way we want to make winning matches more rewarding while also giving those less experienced players the chance to get cool cosmetics via the player progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/cd67793fe6c3dd8c6c5e4b160151211a956576a8.gif[/img]

[b]And that's not all![/b] We've also revamped the end-game scoreboard so that it displays your experience earned that match, even when losing! We've also added some other extras to give it a more polished vibe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/89bb165e99d82c08d8326de480ff1439816972c7.gif[/img]

[i]We do however, want to be clear about this: the amount of experience, point distribution, drop-chance, loot amount, etc... is all bound to change while we gather more feedback. Many factors are involved with player progression. Especially because we've completely overhauled our previous system. In the end we want the progression system to be enjoyable and rewarding for both experienced and new players while also encouraging you to win and perform certain tasks on the ship.[/i] 

[b]There are still a few bugs and one crash. We are working very hard to fix them asap with a hotfix![/b]

We're also working on the exchanging post, where you'll be able to trade your tradable duplicates or unwanted items for new item drops! We expect to release this feature shortly after this update! 


[h2]Ghost Ship[/h2]

In the final zone a [b]Ghost Ship[/b] will now also rise from the depths to make the final zone a bit more interesting and challenging. The ghost ship is littered with loot and equipped with cannons that can be used by both you or your enemies! Each time it rises all 3 rocks will have a random height above the water. It also is a perfect vantage point for those experienced sharpshooters. By adding this we want to encourage players to use different tactics to win the game instead of just endlessly circling each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/f4b76b6fd49ed4916138cd3ca85122245e36ce3e.gif[/img]

Hope you're all excited scallywags! We certainly are! 


[h2]Patch notes version 1.6[/h2]

[h3]Level and progression system:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added levels (unlimited max cap)

notes.title: Update 1.5.5: Quickplay, water shader tweaks, extra sail settings & more!
notes.content:
Yarrr me hearties!

It's been a short while but here we are again with another juicy update. We got quite a bit of new things to cover, so let's get into it!

[u][h3]Quickplay[/h3][/u]
First of all we would like to (re)introduce [b]QUICKPLAY[/b]! No more tediously searching for that perfect match. Just press quickplay, select a gamemode and let our new system do the rest. You can choose between Battle Royale, Conquest or just any gamemode if you just want to get into the action ASAP!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/2a09e294e5c71dabf87c727e20de7cbf3359a1b8.jpg[/img]


[u][h3]Water shader tweaks[/h3][/u]
Next up we have tweaked the water shader. 

The specular has been remade from scratch which now produces a nicer specular highlight. 

Secondly, we've also revamped the subsurface system so it now uses your view angle and shows a nicer gradient of light scattering through the wave tops. 

We've also tweaked how wave foam looks in the distance, it now no longer shows obvious tiling but instead fades out into soft foam banks. 

The waves are now also a slight bit higher and more wild in the open ocean which will also affect gameplay a little bit. Broadside battles and pursuits should be a bit more fun and challenging now. 

Last but not least we've also tweaked the colors and made some changes to the shader so we can have deeper colors. All of this should come at the same cost as the old water shader version. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/c054a90b0d5e93541d9b032f97a20f9fae62b1ab.jpg[/img]


[u][h3]Conquest flag radius indicators[/h3][/u]
We've added some handy radius indicators to the conquest flags.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/eb4763b2ef9d20bcca0873b661aa0baf96d4acce.jpg[/img]


[u][h3]New pirate cosmetics[/h3][/u]
Additionally we've also added some new pirate cosmetics such as underpants, shorts and some salty new tattoos. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/184232d2661fb2f4da0e3e235b85d827fae6e807.jpg[/img]


[u][h3]Interactive tutorial[/h3][/u]
Aside from all that we've also added a fully playable interactive tutorial and removed the super old video.

[b]*note: We are aware of a small oversight of battle drinks (old healing system) still being part of the tutorial. We will fix this in the next hotfix. For now just ignore this hint.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/3d124493032ea05a4c4f718d5f3c668f8ff58160.gif[/img]


[u][h3]Extra sail settings[/h3][/u]
And you can now add micro tears, dirt and paint wear to your sails to get that wooden tub looking just the way you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/161d580ecd9adf79794c7fdc0d6b344c78fe3f8b.gif[/img]



[u][b]There's even more, but we'll leave that to the patch notes below:[/b][/u]

[h3]Quickplay:[/h3]

notes.title: Version 1.5.4: New healing system, Bird's Reef rework & more!
notes.content:
Arrr ye landlubbers! It be once again time for another update.

What is a pirate game without the ability to drink (excessive) amounts of beverage?

...

A landlubber game! 

So, from now on you'll have to [b]drink[/b] that delicious [i]BattleDrink™[/i]. With the new healing system you'll have to take out your bottle and drink up me hearty! Of course while enjoying your refreshing [i]BattleDrink™[/i] you'll want to make sure you are in a safe spot, as other pirates are always looking for opportune moments to end you. 

While drinking you can move around at walking speed, but can't jump or do anything else. You can stop drinking whenever you want. And when you are full health the bottle will automatically recharge with a speed that is based on how much was left in the bottle. Each bottle charge can refill 50% your HP and when fully consumed takes about 10 seconds to refill.

notes.title: Update 1.5.3: Experimental Conquest Game Mode
notes.content:
Ahoy lads!

In the last year we've ventured far and wide, but the time has come to explore a new horizon. Today we would like to introduce our next step into new uncharted waters.

During the last few weeks we've been working on a new game mode that should hopefully bring a more casual shooting ground into the world of Blazing Sails. Battle Royale is fun and all, but sometimes a pirate just wants to.. you know.. kill and destroy. Now you'll be able to do just that! No more forehead melting, nail biting stakes that kick you out of the game once ye olde floating tub goes down. In our new (experimental) Conquest game mode you can just join, kill, destroy, capture and repeat a whole match long without the fear of being kicked out when your floaty float sinks to the ocean floor. The ideal game mode to practice your pirating skills or just have some good old destructive fun!

Note however that the new Conquest game mode is not finished yet and is still in an experimental phase. If you wish to have a more bug free, balanced experience it's still advised to play the Battle Royale mode. We'll be constantly updating and improving the conquest mode over the following weeks and months. So please leave all your feedback in our discord under the #feedback channel to help us shape this game mode into the ultimate pirate battle experience.


Here are the full patch notes:

[h3]New Game Mode:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Experimental Conquest Game Mode added! (All russian servers are hosting Conquest)
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unfinished pump upgrade no longer appears in seagull crates

notes.title: BIG Update 1.5.0: NEW MORTAR SHIP TYPE "The Bomb Vessel" & more!
notes.content:
Ahoy my dear Scallywags! 

[h3][b]First of all: We have detected and fixed a bug with the server map filters. They were disabled by default making it appear as if there are no servers. This is now fixed and people that experienced this bug should now see servers. Apologies for the issue![/b][/h3]

In other news... Time for another [b]BIG[/b] update. As mentioned in our [url=https://www.blazingsails.com/roadmap]roadmap[/url], [b]we've added a NEW SHIP TYPE: The Bomb Vessel.[/b]

This ship has a completely new cannon type: [b]The mortar cannon[/b]. It shoots regular ol' cannonballs, is fully upgradable and especially powerful against those flthy deck-dwelling bilge rats. 

When entering the mortar cannon you'll see your ship in seagull's view and you can see & adjust the trajectory of your cannonball when fired. It is quite tricky at first to hit moving ships but when you do... Oh boy... It sure does pack a punch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/23210c77071d8a4253f97b7810294e4fc6d020a2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/c8d2b4e3e89174ea3126705594039a07f4c2ad9d.gif[/img]

In terms of speed and ship health the Bomb Vessel is between the Junk Ship and Brigantine. (Ship stats below)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/90230aa7131c842eab246eff07882093da5b6da5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/912915b4df88a80e61bb1539b35f7a75ddc7d6aa.jpg[/img]

The layout of the ship is quite different from the Junker or Brigantine, you got 1 regular cannon on both the left and right side but also two(!) swivel slots on each side. As with the other ships there's a swivel slot in the back but you got some extra cover when using this swivel cannon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/c407cd29e7cdc41d1030255083d9bc40c77d3f35.gif[/img] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/c0aaf3373dc37679dbd9945b3e2d357e805b086c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/59e9b573efcf73a1c44d6ded7c0fba9e67f40404.png[/img]

Below the deck we've also spiced it up a bit, It has a... you know what, I'll just show you: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/a5fc4ff44e39d74792b9179cffb6da59f16441c7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/386c778d45a638feefbaca1018c27d9945c0051e.png[/img]

Now, some of you might be asking: "Where are my pump and cork upgrades?" No worries, we're working hard on getting those in asap. So you can expect these soon™.


[u]Without further ado, here are the full patch notes:[/u]

[h3]New ship type:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bomb Vessel added. A mortar ship with 2 cannons, 5 swivel positions and average speed and health.
[*] Mortar cannon which fires a fast firing highly arcing projectile that does does AOE player and ship damage. Mortar projectiles also explode when impacting the water surface.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a maximum interaction angle to ship lamps so they no longer consume interaction

[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.4.3.1: Ship culling fix, votekick improvements, score tweaks & more!
notes.content:
Ahoy lads!

We've got a small hotfix today addressing some bugs and we did some improvements on the votekick system and score amounts.

We also identified a major bug in the ship culling (performance) system which caused the entire system to malfunction and thus not be active. We fixed the problem and now ship culling should work as intended. This should give a noticeable FPS increase and might drastically increase FPS on weak or mid-range CPU based systems. Especially during matches with a lot of ships (5+), there should be less frame drops and average FPS should be higher.


Patch notes:

[h3]Party and votekicking improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Enable Team Fill" checkbox renamed to "Lock Party" and thus inverted
[*] Party members can now bypass a locked party and always re-enter
[*] Scoreboard now shows how many players a crew has kicked
[*] Players that were kicked out of a team can no longer rejoin said team
[/list]

[h3]Score changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Normal cannonball hits now grant 20 points instead of 5
[*] Heavy cannonball hits now grant 30 points instead of 10
[*] Trap shot hits now grant 40 points instead of 15
[*] Anti-sail hits now grant 25 points instead of 10
[*] Explosive barrel hits now grant 80 points instead of 20
[*] Anti cannon hits now grant 40 points instead of 15
[/list]

[h3]Bonus reward for smaller crews:[/h3]
[list]
[*] If a crew has not kicked anyone during the entire match and wins with less players than the 2nd placed crew, each winning crew player gets an extra bonus reward
[/list]

[h3]Ship ladder tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Climbing sound volume decreased from 1 to 0.4
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Fixed a major bug with the ship culling that caused it to not work at all. There should be less framedrops and higher average FPS[/b][/u]
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused previous weapon to not be re-equiped when leaving swimming state or climbing on deck from a ship ladder. Now your previous weapon will always be re-equiped properly
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to enter a vehicle when trying to pick up loot close to a vehicle when keybind of looting and interacting is the same
[*] Ladder climbing no longer jitters when climbing ladders on sinking ships
[*] Right click being stuck sometimes should be fixed
[*] Sprint not working sometimes should be fixed
[*] Fixed a small visual text issue with votekick and other kick or ban chat messages being cutoff and thus unreadable
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.4.3: New ladder climbing system, In-game crew locking & more!
notes.content:
Ahoy landlubbers!

Today we've got an exciting new update for you all! Any pirate worth their salt loves a good boarding, swashbuckling with your enemies on their deck while the wind whips around you. However, boarding was difficult to stop with how easy it was to get on another team's ship. 

Too many pirates were teleporting around, dipping on and off the deck. These wormhole jumpers will have to a find another hobby as of today because we are proud to introduce ACTUAL ladders (or well, ropes)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/f800f5793579e38d4caaac1f51e56af8320edf62.gif[/img]


[u]Here are the full patch notes:[/u]

[h3]Ship ladders:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ship ladders have been completely overhauled and now include a climbing animation
[*] Ship ladders now require you to hold interact (E) to climb all the way up to the deck
[/list]

[h3]In-game crew locking:[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now lock your crew during the match (press escape and navigate to crew management)
[b][i]Note: please refrain from kicking players to create free spaces. If there is a chance a friend of yours will join later, simply keep your crew locked until (s)he joins the game. Then you can unlock and (s)he can join the team.[/i][/b]
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved visual smoothness of getting onto ships from the air
[*] Improved visual smoothness of getting onto elevators
[*] Anti-Sail cannonball sail damage increased from 15 to 20
[*] TNT damage radius decreased from 1700 to 1200
[*] Normal cannonball, anti-sail, anti-cannon and trap shot player damage decreased from 100 to 60
[*] Swivel cannonball player damage decreased from 100 to 40
[*] Cannonballs (of any type) no longer cause extra damage when hitting the head (headshot multiplier disabled on cannonballs)
[b][i]Note: cannonballs still do AOE (Area Of Effect) damage in a radius. A normal cannonball will now deal 60 damage + 30 AOE damage on a direct hit, for a total of 90 damage. 
All the damage values can be found here: https://blazingsails.fandom.com/wiki/Cannon_Projectiles[/i][/b]

[/list]

[h3]Sounds and effects:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added sounds to ladder climbing and vaulting onto the deck
[*] New hammer repair sound
[*] Added smoke puff to mast repairing
[/list]

[h3]Key binds:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an extra / separate key bind for picking up loot
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Incorrectly loaded characters no longer have an outfit (brown jacket, black bicorn, one sandal) but are now in default clothing (only pants)
[*] Sprinting headbob no longer plays while using the world map
[*] Fixed a bug that caused pirates to be wearing white wrist wraps when not having any hand slot items selected for the first time
[*] Fixed a bug with ship saving and selecting in the main menu
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.3.5: Player Reporting, more status icons, teleport effects and more
notes.content:
Hi there pirates! 

It's update time again. We've got a few things for you all this week. The long awaited player reporting feature has been added. Pirates aren't the kindest souls, let's admit. But even pirates agree on certain lines that shouldn't be crossed. Spoiling the fun for others or spouting extreme profanity should not go unpunished. And thus, we will from now on review your reports and take actions accordingly to keep the seas as adventurous and fun as possible for everyone sailing on them. Actions may range from warnings all the way to server bans depending on the gravity of the offense.

Next to that we've got some new teleport effects, some more status icons and a brigantine buff!

[h3]Reporting:[/h3]
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/0db265b631471aee5748d5445fdc1d3cd07dc445.gif[/img]

notes.title: Early Access ROADMAP update 4: FEMALE PIRATE release date and more!
notes.content:
Ahoy mateys! 

As some of you have might have already suspected, our full release has been pushed a bit further back than we originally intended. Mainly because we don't feel comfortable with fully launching right now. And let's face it: there's still quite some stuff that a fully released game [b]should[/b] have. Like a solid progression system, more QoL, overall stability and more.

But like a wise old buccaneer once told me: [b]"A delayed game is eventually good, a rushed game is forever bad"[/b]

That being said we can't begin to express how thankful we are towards you pirates! Many of you have shown a lot of patience and passion towards our game and that really motivates us to keep developing Blazing Sails into the ultimate PvP pirate game. 

We're always very excited to share our latest updates, monitor your feedback and make changes/improvements accordingly. Let's keep this going!


[h3]Now, without further ado here's [b]PART 2 of our Early Access Roadmap:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/458016ea728c1156ac2186634f006015503cfe4c.jpg[/img]
Check out a high-res version [url=https://www.blazingsails.com/roadmap]here[/url]


As you can see the long requested [b]female pirate character[/b] option will be added soon™ along with some very [b]handy backpack upgrades.[/b] Gone are the days of being stuck at sea with only a bunch of sweaty guys. With the backpack upgrades you'll be able to bring some more plunder as well for the special occasion. 

So instead of adding multiple small features we've decided to mainly focus the next big update around one [b]MAJOR[/b] addition. Adding the female character was a lot of work for us since we also needed to adjust all outfits to fit both body types. (So yes, bearded ladies will be possible!)

Of course, in case you didn't notice the additions in the far left corner of the Roadmap; more QoL, extra additions, bugfixes and other improvements is something we'll keep focusing on as well throughout Early Access.


See you on the seas pirates!



Like this Roadmap update? Let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/blazingsails]Discord![/url]

notes.title: Update 1.3.3: Weapon balance overhaul, improvements and bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello there seadogs! We've got another small but relatively significant update for you all this week with some changes to the weapons in Blazing Sails. 

We've seen a lot of pirates falling back to the same loadouts again and again to the point where it became obvious some of the weapons were too dominant. Namely the musket and sniper rifles. Some of the sidearms weren't getting much love either due to them being overshadowed by the stronger weapons. So we took another good look at the balance and did some changes to hopefully put all the weapons in the game on a more even playing field. We ideally want every weapon in the game to be viable and serve a purpose. The multi barrel weapons for example weren't solid enough in combat versus the one shot weapons which were quite fast to reload and therefor overall more reliable than multi shot weapons. With today's balancing update one shot weapons have received a slower reload time which should make the multi shot weapons a more attractive choice. We've also tweaked the fire rate of some of the sidearms to allow them to shoot their bullets faster to increase their DPS.

Of course changes like these are based on feedback and what we see from the community. Nor are these changes or any changes we make ever final. If things turn out to be worse, we will have another look and as many after that as needed to get it right. We are still very much in early access and still molding the game to get the overall experience as awesome and balanced as possible.

[u]Full patch notes below:[/u]

[h3]Weapon balance rework:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dragon pistol reload time increased from 2.3s to 2.5s
[*] Musket reload time increased from 1.8s to 2.3s
[*] Fast Sniper reload time increased from 1.8s to 2.2s
[*] Heavy Sniper reload time increased from 1.8s to 2.5s
[*] Crossbow reload time increased from 1.8s to 2.5s
[*] Flintlock reload time increased from 1.3s to 1.8s
[*] Quad Barrel flintlock fire cooldown decreased from 0.35s to 0.20s
[*] Dual Flintlock fire cooldown decreased from 0.25s to 0.10s
[*] Dual Flintlock projectile damage decreased from 40 to 35
[*] Dual Quad Barrel flintlocks fire rate decreased from 0.25s to 0.18s
[/list]

[h3]Cosmetic changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jolly Roger flag emblem and sail emblem made a bit bigger
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay options:[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now manually set the time it takes to drop your own anchor (min 0 seconds to max 1 second)
[/list]

notes.content:
Ahoy me hearteys!

The Lunar New Year will soon be upon us (depending on when you're reading this)! That means it's time for Blazing Sails' [b]Lunar Lands[/b] update. This is potentially our [u]biggest update yet[/u], with a new island, new cosmetics, a new feature, and TONS of QoL updates!

[h2]Check out the trailer![/h2]

[previewyoutube=HIUhn_PiBzw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Lunar Lands[/h2]
As with every major update, this one brings an all-new set of islands with it: The Lunar Lands. These massive rocky pillars are connected through walkways and bridges, and make for excellent sniping spots. You'll find the Lunar Lands in the North, between the Trident and Bandit Bay clusters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/bd8508440212fe9b611f49acbb6d8e592baf8143.gif[/img]

[h2]Sail Damage[/h2]
Do you aim your cannons too high? Are you constantly surprised by the incredible laser accuracy of the patented Blazing Sails Cannons™? Well, now you too can be of use, with sail damage! When you hit an enemy sail, it will take some damage, causing their ship to slow down.

To further celebrate the Lunar New Year, we've created a bunch of oxcellent and oxciting new cosmetics for you to get yer grubby hands on! Always wanted to be a pirate wearing a dragon hat? Same here, that's why we made 'em.

notes.title: Sneak Peek: SAIL DAMAGE!
notes.content:
Ahoy ye scurvy Seadogs! In preparation of our upcoming [b]BIG LUNAR UPDATE[/b] (coming soon™) we'd like to share a little preview of the sail damage we'll be adding soon. No longer will you look like a fool for shooting a tad too high and missing the hull, because sails will soon become a juicy target.

And we'll make the joke for you. Yes, Blazing Sails will soon have actual blazing sails.

Without further ado, check out the video below for the full sail damage preview!

[previewyoutube=ZdG5xHjtw_4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Sail Damage for dummies[/h3]
It's very simple: damaged sails will cause your ship to sail slower the more damaged they are. Luckily sail damage can easily be repaired by hammering the mast and [u]doesn't require any resource[/u]!

[h3]How will sail damage impact gameplay?[/h3]
Speaking from experience (we've had sail damage during the pre-alpha) we know this feature adds a lot of extra depth to the gameplay and rewards teamwork even more. While the hull will stay the most important thing to repair during a match, sail damage and thus sailing speed can heavily impact the outcome of a game. Especially now with the recently added, agile Junk Ship we felt like this was the perfect time to re-introduce this feature to the game. Also during chase-situations damaging the sails can come in quite handy.

[h3]Will certain cannonball-types do more damage?[/h3]
Yes! And not only that. We've added a new special cannonball type to the game: [b]"The Anti-Sail Cannonball"[/b]. This is a commonly found type of ball that does a lot of sail damage. All other cannonballs can also damage sails but do far less damage than the Anti-Sail. Thus, they are less effective at damaging sails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/8273daccecd248df794de837102e3995f0705a1f.gif[/img]

[h3]Why don't I need cloth or another resource to repair sails?[/h3]
While we think having even more resources is not preferable at this point we know from testing (we also had cloth in the prototype) that the need for a resource for type of damage is highly unpractical. Imagine being out in the ocean, your sails completely shredded, you look in your inventory and what do you NOT see? Cloth. You're stranded. (in the deadzone maybe) Have fun sailing at 1 meter per hour to any island or crates. Hence, this would greatly reduce the fast-paced flow of the game.



That about wraps it up pirates! Hope you're excited for the upcoming update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/d4c6022268d195e556c622a63bee9f9d944767fb.gif[/img]

You probably know the feeling of aiming too high and seeing your cannonball magically whizz through an enemy sail. Well, no more! With the Lunar New Year update, we will be adding sail damage. Damaged sails will cause your ship to sail slower. Of course, these can be repaired easily by simply hammering your masts. This added feature will add an extra twist to the current gameplay and can be very handy during a chase situation. 

[h3]Lunar Lands[/h3]
The Lunar Lands are a collection of steep rocks connected by wooden bridges. Though it has been long since abandoned, there’s still plenty of loot to be found, and the tall buildings make for excellent sniping spots!

[u]Here's a little foretaste [/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/787bbea47cf7be9e2eec6040c191b56be1bbbf1f.png[/img]


[h3]Lunar New Year Cosmetics[/h3]
Of course, no celebration is complete without some new cosmetics! We’ve got some oxcellent ideas cooked up for the year of the ox. Stay tuned for more. 


[u][b]Without further ado, here's the updated roadmap:[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/f9625de23132bacfd8e27e395dce3ee2f7624eac.png[/img]

Find a full resolution version [url=https://www.blazingsails.com/roadmap]here.[/url]


[h3]Re: Optimisation[/h3]
To those asking for better optimisation -- we hear you! Our new team members are eager to jump on this issue. We've recently recruited a new programmer at Get Up Games to help further polish and improve Blazing Sails. We've also found an external partner that will focus on nativising our project. If all goes well this should definitely improve the overall performance. Later this year we've got a few interns joining our team. We believe they'll be able to learn a lot during their stay but also contribute in the further development of our game.

Long story short: some nice updates and optimisations are on the way. The future is looking bright and we simply can't wait to continue further development! 

[h3]Sale![/h3]
On top of all that we've got a [b]Daily Deal Sale[/b] going on right now! (Praise our lord and saviour Gaben) Get Blazing Sails at [b]25% off[/b] right now! The sale will end on the 27th of this month at 7pm CET. So what arrrr ye' waiting for scallywag? Grab it while it's hot!!



Let us know what you think about our updated Roadmap on [url=https://discord.gg/blazingsails]Discord![/url]

notes.title: Update 1.2.4: Long distance gun sounds, defeated crew weapon drops and more
notes.content:
Ahoy ye scallywags!

If a cannon fires in the distance, but no one is around to hear it, does it still make a sound? The answer to that is yes, and with today's update, it'll make a much cooler sound than before! And it's not just regular cannons -- swivels and fast snipers also got a bit of an auditory upgrade.

There's some other changes that you've been requesting, like smoother transitions when jumping from ship to ship, and player weapons dropping when their team is defeated!

[h3]Sound overhauls:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New cannon sounds
[*] New swivel cannon sounds
[*] New fast sniper firing sound
[*] Some water and ship sounds slightly reduced in volume
[*] Cannon sounds optimized (consumes less audio channels)
[*] Distant sounds added to all weapons
[*] New cannonball air travel sound
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Characters jumping from ship to ship should no longer teleport away for a split second (transition should be smoother)
[*] When dropping weapons in the water they will now go up and down with the waves
[*] Junk ship frontal damage points moved a bit so they no longer appear inside the hangmats
[*] Player weapon drops:
[*] All weapons now drop from a player [u]if his team is defeated[/u] or when he disconnects
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/ef10e7bf4de6a2ba26e3993ec7f0c0c9d240ce7f.gif[/img]


[h3]Damage:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sprint is now blocked for 1 second by any type of damage, not only melee anymore
[/list]

[h3]Ship gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Turning speed now increases and decreases depending on ship speed and no longer depending on sail deployment (sharper turns when anchored)
[*] Turning speed is now slightly faster when stationary (60% when going full speed and 100% when stationary, half speed would be 80%)
[/list]

[h3]Optimisations:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed some leftover components from the character (cleanup)
[*] Improved collision performance on character
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused turning speed to be slowest instead of fastest when stationary until you used the sails
[*] Fixed a bug that caused more than 16 players to be able to join pre-game servers
[*] Bow mounted barrels should now work again
[*] Fixed "Not enough room" warning when trying to steal ship items with a full inventory
[*] Fixed incorrect metal rope attachment points LOD material
[/list]

notes.title: DESIGN your postcard and WIN an amazing prize!
notes.content:
Avast ye frozen-over seadogs!

With the holiday season upon us, we’ve prepared a little competition for ye pirates. Discover the ins and outs of the new Icy Caverns, and send your crewmates a commemorative postcard to let them know you still care ♥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/a42d82e7c5594661aa469a5bad3740b548f022b7.gif[/img]

[h2]The Contest[/h2]
The contest is simple: [u]create a postcard of your pirate at the Icy Caverns.[/u] It can be holiday-themed, funny, artsy, whatever you want! Just follow these simple rules.

[list]
[*] The competition starts on December 21st (now) and ends on January the 4th 5pm CET.
[*] A maximum of two entries are allowed per person.
[*] All entries must be submitted in the Official [url=https://discord.gg/r7nuxnWZJf]Blazing Sails Discord[/url] #postcard-competition channel to be eligible.
[*] Postcard designs including offensive, political or NSFW content will automatically be disqualified. 
[*] Plundering other contestants' designs will also get ye disqualified. 
[/list]

And here are [b]some tips[/b] for getting the perfect shot:

[list]
[*] Hold F while in game, and select the 'Inspect Yourself' option to see your pirate in 3rd person.
[*] Type [i]/hh[/i] in chat to hide your HUD. Useful for getting a better 1st person shot!
[*] For the artiest of artists, try hosting your own game with yer mateys, then type [i]/scam[/i] to enter spectator mode. You can then freely move around with your camera! Use the mousewheel to control the camera speed, and backspace to leave spectator mode.
[/list]

[h2]The plunder[/h2]
The legendary creators of the five best postcards will have their usernames immortalized within the Icy Caverns! That's right, if you win the contest, your name will be engraved on our brand new island. 

You'll also receive a Steam key to give away -- t'is the season after all.

[h2]Examples[/h2]
Below are a few examples!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/0f6dc74fc9e45588bb41724dcea1b1d278afb344.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/82e0199ce28d95a5ec8de79ee09f0cba2f4c14f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/cccd87f7acc5324f4f51b91897f75d92fedb8e48.jpg[/img]


That's it for now, pirates. Good luck, have fun!

notes.title: MAJOR Update 1.2: NEW SHIP, Winter Event and more!
notes.content:
Ho ho hyarr! 

We're proud to release our [b]biggest update[/b] since Early Access launch! Better put on a warm coat and get them mittens ready because this update too just [b]cool[/b] to handle without! 

Want to get up to speed on everything immediately? Check out the trailer below!
[previewyoutube=oFc_-zPaefw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]An all new ship[/h2]
We love Brigs, but we also love variation. That's why we're introducing the brand-new Junk ship, inspired by ancient Chinese sailboats. The Junk is a lot faster than the Brig, best for hit-and-run tactics and boarding. Did we mention the [b]front-facing cannon?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/1e59bd81f652cecda02856f8f8480b4167319369.gif[/img]

[h2]The Icy Caverns[/h2]
Want to take your Junk ship for a spin in unexplored lands? You can! The Icy Caverns have drifted their way into Blazing Sails. This massive expanse of solid ice holds lots of loot for your crew to plunder. It's got plenty of space to have a good ol' fashioned brawl in, and lots of nooks and crannies for devious pirates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818716/a42d82e7c5594661aa469a5bad3740b548f022b7.gif[/img]

Why be a regular pirate when you can be an angry snowman pirate? [u]For a limited time only[/u], you can earn a ton of unique holiday-themed cosmetics for both you and your ship!

notes.title: Sneak Peek: NEW SHIP!

Ahoy landlubbers!

We're proud to announce our upcoming new ship type: [u][b]The Junk Ship![/b][/u]
This ship will be dropping along with our soon to come major winter update! 

This design was inspired by ancient Chinese sailing ships. In comparison to the brig, the junk ship is smaller and trades in some firepower and ship health in return for incredible speeds. You also won't have to fiddle around with TNT barrels when going straight ahead, as the junk has a FRONT FACING CANNON! And no, that ain't a swivel -- that's a full-blown upgradeable cannon!

[h3]Here's sneak peek tour:[/h3]

[previewyoutube=UyB6jYcbKyw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Is it better than a Brig?[/h3]

We're going to be monitoring things carefully to make sure both ships are viable and balanced. In a straight firefight, the Brig still has an edge, but the Junk is able to maneuver around much faster, dipping in and out of range! Boarding should also be easier for the Junk ship, as you can quickly drop off some mean looking lads, then get out before the brig can respond.

So to answer that question: it's not supposed to be better -- just different. 


[h3]Wasn't it supposed to be a 2-3 person ship?[/h3]

That was the initial idea, but then we noted one issue: there's a lot of premade 4-man crews out there, and we don't want to deprive them of our beautiful Junk (heh). We're still open to other options (it is Early Access, after all) but for now, the Junk can also be manned by up to 4 players!

That said, because it has more of a focus on boarding, 3-player parties should still be able to win if they use the Junk effectively!


[h3]How many cannons does it have?[/h3]

Right now the Junker is equiped with a total of two normal side cannons, and one in in the front. You also have the ability to install swivels of course! One on each side (behind the normal ones) and one in the back. (like with the Brig)


[h3]Does it sink faster?[/h3]

Yes! The playstyle we want encourage with this ship type is agile and fast, but not tanky. So you better watch them repairs when playing with the Junk Ship!


[h3]Does the Junk have a cork?[/h3]

Does a pirate poop in a bucket? OF COURSE!

Hope you pirates are excited for this addition! We'll share more info on our upcoming winter update very soon. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.6: Performance increase and FXAA added!
notes.content:
Hi there ye seadogs! 

We've got another small update for you. We've been receiving quite a few complaints about performance and have noticed ourselves that we've seem to have lost some FPS along the last few weeks so we did some digging. Not to find treasures for once, but to find the culprit of the problem and we found it. Something was amiss with the ship lamps that caused a big drop in performance whenever a ship would have default (orange) lanterns. We also spotted some other strangeness that caused some performance issues with the floating wood crates, that as well is now fixed. Below the full patch notes:


[h1]Performance increase / bug fixing:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Big performance leak fixed with ship lanterns when using default (orange) lanterns
[*] Collision overhead fixed with seagulls above floating wood crates which also improves performance
[/list]

[h1]Video options:[/h1]

[list]
[*] You can now choose between temporal anti-aliasing (Temporal AA) and fast approximate anti-aliasing (FXAA)
[*] Added "Ultra" setting for anti-aliasing
[*] Renamed lowest anti-aliasing setting from "Low" to "Off"
[/list]

[h1]Servers:[/h1]

[list]
[*] There should now be a few more pre-games ready to receive players in Europe and Russia
[/list]

Hopefully these fixes and optimisations will give you pirates some smoother sailing!

This Early Access period is all about experimentation and growth for us. Not just for the actual game, but things like pricing and community, too. We’ve heard your feedback, and are happy to announce that we’ll be [b]dropping the price for Blazing Sails[/b] during its Early Access period. This’ll be happening later this week, alongside some other very exciting happenings. If you’ve been trying to get yer mateys aboard Blazing Sails, make sure they stay tuned!

[h3]Price drop[/h3]

[h3]I bought the game at $24.99, what now?[/h3]
